thresholds.note: Hierarchical overrides: profile → group → node. The most specific scope wins.
thresholds.explainer: Every alert Yagra raises from polling comes from a rule here, node up/down included. Each is evaluated live on every matching poll sample; the most-specific scope wins, and a rule at "every node" is the fleet default. Warning/critical bounds and the number of consecutive breaches before it commits (anti-flap) are per rule. Reachability is the exception to one of those: it has no bounds, because a node either answered or it did not — only the breach count applies.
thresholds.noLiveness: No reachability rule exists, so a node going down raises no alert and sends no notification. Node state on the Nodes page still updates. Add a rule on Reachability to start paging again.

scopeIdNoun.global: This rule applies to every node. Anything you set at a profile, group or node scope overrides it.

addModal.dwellTitle: Consecutive breaches: readings that must cross the bound in a row before the alert fires
addModal.boundsHint: Warn / crit / breaches are optional. Breaches is how many consecutive readings must cross the bound before the alert fires — higher values suppress flapping (rapid on/off alerts).
addModal.folderGroupHint: Applies to this group and every group inside it. A rule on a group further in wins over this one.
addModal.legacyTagHint: Legacy scope: matches a node's tag value, not the folder tree. Kept so existing rules keep working — new rules use a folder group.
